M-PROJECTS.NAME: Monorepo project discovery
M-PROJECTS.purpose: Discover every MyGRACE project under a directory tree and report per-project counts, lint findings and verification coverage (Wave 3.7).

export-DEFAULT_SCAN_CAP.PURPOSE: Hard cap on scanned directories (2000); exceeding it sets truncated instead of hanging.

fn-discoverProjects.PURPOSE: Bounded BFS, skips configured ignoreDirs plus .git/node_modules/.bun*/dist/build/coverage; returns roots, depth, scannedDirs, truncated.

fn-summarizeProject.PURPOSE: Per-project counts, lint error/warning totals, coverage counters and clean/findings status via the same APIs as status/lint/ci.

fn-aggregateProjects.PURPOSE: Totals across discovered projects (modules, phases, verifications, errors, warnings).

CrossLink.relation: per-project counts come from the status snapshot
lint findings are collected with the same detectors
coverage counters reuse the ci collector

contract.purpose: Answer "what MyGRACE projects live in this tree and how healthy are they?" without reading every per-entity file.

param.name: summaries
param.description: counts, lint, coverage, status, findings per project plus totals.

error.description: Invalid depth/format or unreadable scan root — exit 2.
Any project has lint errors → exit 1; --strict also fails on warnings.

notes.note-1: Read-only: bounded BFS, no writes, no project-command execution, no network.
notes.note-2: Discovery is marker-based (docs/graph-index.xml), so nested and sibling projects are both found deterministically.
notes.note-3: Exit policy: 0 clean, 1 any findings, --strict promotes warnings; a truncated scan is reported, never silently ignored.
